categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Adds script execution tracing functionality directly exposed through the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper across src/kernel/.
categories.rationale: Exposes intermediate script evaluation states through the kernel API to enable external tooling like debuggers and execution visualizers. The PR description notes that external consumers previously had no way to observe intermediate execution states, and multiple reviewers confirmed successfully building visualizers and driving the C API across thousands of spends.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Excluded by category definition: primary subject is the kernel API, and the trace hooks in src/script/interpreter.cpp compile to no-ops by default without substantively altering validation logic.
categories.rationale: The PR does not substantively alter consensus rules or validation logic; the validation category explicitly excludes changes whose primary subject is the kernel library API.
